title: Has anyone else noticed a recent uptick in anomalous events? (Syncronicities, vivid dreams, etc…)

classification.theory_summary: Speculates that recent unlikely/anomalous events and increased Mall World dreams may indicate an astral plane/universal consciousness linking people across space/time; references Paul Stamets' universal mycelial network idea.
classification.question_topic: Whether others have noticed a recent uptick (last month) in synchronicities/anomalous events and/or Mall World dreams; asks about strength/frequency changes.
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream narrative, locations, spatial layout, entities, or events are described; author explicitly withholds specifics.

meta.author_theory: Reports having 'spectacularly unlikely and/or unusual' events in the last few weeks and is 'almost completely convinced' there is an 'astral plane' or 'universal consciousness' linking separate people and times; references a 'universal mycelial network' connecting 'all space and time' in a higher dimension.

extraction.extraction_notes: Only temporal framing is provided ('last month or so', 'last few weeks') and a general claim of increased/vivid Mall World dreams/synchronicities; no concrete dream scenes, places, paths, entities, or boundaries are described.
